description: Install the Shopify storefront tracking pixel on the connected store, or repoint an existing one at this account. This is what turns on product views, cart activity, and browse abandonment - the data every browse-abandonment and cart-recovery sequence depends on. Idempotent: an already-live pixel returns `changed: false`. Events start flowing on the next storefront visit and nothing is backfilled for the period the pixel was off, so run it before, not after, building the sequence. If the store granted an older permission set, this fails with a message naming the reconnect step rather than silently doing nothing. Shopify only.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

integrationId.description: Shopify integration ID from list_integrations or get_integration.

name: activate_integration_pixel

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `activate_integration_pixel` MCP tool.

changed.description: False when the pixel was already installed and reporting to this account.

created.description: True when a new pixel was installed.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

shopDomain.description: Store the pixel was installed on.

updated.description: True when an existing pixel was repointed at this account.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
